sloka: स धनुर्धन्विनां श्रेष्ठः प्रगृह्य सुसमाहितः।मुमोचाशीविषप्रख्यान् शरान् देहविदारणान् ।। ६.७६.३८ ।।
transliteration: sa dhanurdhanvināṁ śreṣṭhaḥ pragṛhya susamāhitaḥ।mumocāśīviṣaprakhyān śarān dehavidāraṇān ।। 6.76.38 ।।

translations.english: He (Kumbha), the foremost wielder of bow, taking up the bow, remaining fully composed released arrows that resembled poisonous serpents capable of tearing the flesh.
